status: Preliminary screening found existing same-sector uses. The name is not cleared for adoption.

packageSyntax.finding: @neo-ui by itself is a scope, not a complete npm package name. A scoped package requires @scope/name.

npm.command: npm view neo-ui name version description repository.url --json
npm.interpretation: Does not establish that the name can be registered, that a scope is available, or that using the brand is lawful.

trademarkScope.performed: Primary-source product searches, npm lookup, official clearance guidance, and exact-name web searches restricted to USPTO/EUIPO domains.
trademarkScope.notPerformed: A completed professional similarity search of live USPTO, EUIPO/TMview, WIPO and national registers, review of all goods/services, priority, owners, jurisdictions and unregistered rights. JavaScript registry landing pages did not expose searchable records through the web tool; absence of indexed search results is not evidence of absence of marks.
trademarkScope.conclusion: Existing product uses create a concrete naming concern, but this report does not establish infringement or provide a legal clearance opinion. For EU/US release, choose a more distinctive candidate and obtain a trademark clearance review before adopting it internationally.

actions: No package rename, scope reservation, trademark filing or public publication was performed. @ad-voice/ui is unchanged.
